name: @playliquid/build-orchestrator
description: PlayLiquid GameOS build orchestration service (PL-020). Tenant-scoped single-record build intake over @playliquid/build-contracts' admission oracle (E1: malformed, duplicate-payload and unresolvable requests are typed refusals); the E10 orchestration pipeline — package-closure resolution from the registry with the R19 provenance/licensing gate (unauthorized or unprovenanced inputs fail closed with typed reasons, never silent completion), deterministic seeded build planning (E9: digest-pinned inputs, content-addressed environment, canonical call ids), and stage execution of the frozen phase machine through the Tool Fabric runtime seam with every transition recorded as an append-only authority-stamped event; outputs are content-addressed artifact references plus the typed build manifest, provenance and verification evidence, validated by build-contracts' composition validator and the console vendor-SDK gate (lock rule 24). Missing toolchains are recorded as truthful environment limitations (E11), never faked success. The frozen 11-target taxonomy is consumed as target-profile data (R12); tenant isolation is enforced on every command and read (R20). Domain is pure: persistence, time, the registry and Tool Fabric live behind ports with in-memory fakes; the BuildExecutor port from build-contracts is served from recorded, immutable build truth.
